eyebrow.description: Optional short category or section marker, or null.

headline.description: The dominant page headline. On the cover this must exactly equal the document title.

subtitle.description: Optional supporting deck below or beside the headline, or null.

footer.description: Optional visible footer copy, or null. Do not put the Project logo here.

functional_series.description: Explicit identity, purpose, and position only for pages that intentionally repeat one functional tool series.

hierarchy.description: Exact reading priority using reserved header IDs, functional component IDs, cta, and generated_visual.

zones.description: Proportional placement, relative scale, span, and treatment guidance for each component; not pixel-exact coordinates.

WebhookEvent.description: Canonical signed webhook body. Verify HMAC-SHA256 over `<unix timestamp>.<raw body>`, require x-autocontent-event-id to equal body.id, reject timestamps outside a ±300-second window, and deduplicate by id.

AutoContentError.description: Normalized AutoContent error; provider payloads are never returned.

Retry-After.description: Whole seconds before retry when the error supplies a bounded retry time.
